message: `.{port}(...)`: a port connects to a net, not to a value
description: In an instance's port list, each port is connected to a net. A value was written instead; this usually means a parameter override was put in the port list.
actions: If `{port}` is a parameter of the instantiated module, override it in the `#(...)` list before the instance name: `#(.{port}(value)) name(...)`.
If it is a port, connect it to a net.
